loss.only_new_supervision: Camera-A person-mask RGB-D observed surface in metres
loss.surface: one-sided observed point to differentiable barycentric samples of MHR triangles, robust Huber
loss.stability: detached Official initialization predictions preserve 2D joints and pelvis-relative 3D joints; direct L2 preserves head initialization

formal_pilot.selection: lowest VAL subject-macro point-to-triangle mean; ties choose earliest epoch

early_stop.first_window_rule: E1-E10 must complete. Early stopping is disabled through E10; any extension beyond E10 requires a separately frozen epoch budget and starts a fresh patience counter.

validation.primary_selection_metric: mean across VAL subjects of each subject's median frame-level exact observed-to-triangle median distance in mm
validation.secondary_metric: rendered metric Z-depth residual and mesh coverage
validation.tail_metrics: For point-to-triangle and rendered depth, report subject-equal means of per-subject frame-median P90/P95; also report P90/P95 across subject frame-medians for point-to-triangle.
validation.aggregation: subject macro; frames never count as independent subjects
validation.sealed_usage: none until one final, separately authorized evaluation

requires: non-zero finite gradients in both permitted heads
rendered-depth coverage at or above the fixed floor
smoke_gate.meaning: engineering execution integrity only, not efficacy or readiness for deployment

run_state_transition.smoke: Reviewer changes status to FROZEN_FOR_1_EPOCH_SMOKE only after workset QA, final split freeze and loss-weight freeze.
run_state_transition.formal: Reviewer changes status to FROZEN_FOR_FORMAL_PILOT only after a passing smoke and explicit protocol freeze.

mandatory_run_records: baseline and per-epoch Camera-B subject-macro metrics
claim_limit: This protocol authorizes the governed E1-E10 formal pilot. E10 is a review point; no efficacy, deployment, or SEALED-generalization claim exists before review and the single sealed evaluation.
